description: This file is a PHP script for the configuration confirmation step during the installation of vtiger CRM. It handles user input for database and site configuration, checks the database connection, and displays a summary for confirmation before proceeding to the next installation step.

classes.name: Installation_Utils
classes.description: A utility class providing methods for database connection checks during installation.

methods.name: checkDbConnection
methods.description: Checks the database connection with the provided parameters, returning success flag and error messages.
